crates.role: Decoder/Encoder traits, StreamInfo, shared enums, error types
crates.notes: Core API crate, no codec of its own

crates.role: Headerless raw PCM (int8/16/24/32, f32/f64, both byte orders)

Encoder supports fixed predictors only (no full LPC search on the encode side yet)

crates.role: Ogg page/packet container (RFC 3533), shared by Vorbis and Opus
Opus (RFC 6716) decoder and encoder (CELT, SILK, hybrid) + Ogg Opus container (RFC 7845)
crates.encode: recorded scope complete (quality tuning remains, see todo.md)
crates.conformance: 100% final_range match on all 12 official RFC 6716 test vectors; SILK-only vectors PCM bit-exact; residual PCM SNR gap on CELT/hybrid vectors is float-ULP-class, not an entropy desync
crates.notes: Encoder scope complete, all decoder-bit-exact: CELT (mono/stereo, fullband, CBR/VBR, all 4 frame sizes, transient/TF handling, M/S + intensity stereo, dynalloc steering); SILK (reference NSQ + delayed-decision NSQ behind set_complexity, per-frame rate control onto the caller budget, mono + stereo adaptive mid/side, 4-band VAD, Burg LPC, NLSF interpolation search, LBRR/FEC via set_packet_loss_perc, DTX, CBR payload sizing); hybrid SILK+CELT (TOC configs 12-15, mono or stereo, shared range coder); Ogg Opus writing with RFC 7845 pre-skip/granules recovering the exact input sample count

crates.conformance: >100 dB SNR vs FFmpeg (AAC-LC); HE-AAC/SBR fidelity gap fixed (2026-09-23, a window-table sign bug) — ~117-126 dB SNR on self-generated HE-AAC fixtures, up from ~18-23 dB; multichannel HE-AAC SBR (5.1) fixed (2026-09-23, a shared-SBR-context bug) — all 6 channels now ~117-133 dB SNR on a self-generated 5.1 fixture, up from ~-2 dB on all but the last channel element; the official FATE al_sbr_cm_48_2 vector itself wasn't re-measured (network-blocked in this sandbox) but both fixes are content-independent (a shared data table; a per-element state container); 4/8 relevant multichannel FATE vectors still at partial fidelity (separate CCE/PCE issue)
crates.notes: PS/HE-AACv2 unimplemented; encoder on hold pending a licensing decision (Fraunhofer/VIA-LA patent pool)

crates.conformance: >100 dB SNR vs FFmpeg on ten bundled decode fixtures; official ISO/IEC 11172-4 vectors not obtainable, so decode correctness rests on the FFmpeg oracle alone
crates.notes: Mp3Encoder: full CBR and loudness/quality-targeting VBR across MPEG-1/2/2.5 with bit-reservoir borrowing, short-block switching, mid/side + opt-in intensity stereo (MPEG-1 PAN table and the ISO 13818-3 LSF ladder), Info/Xing + LAME gapless tags. The repeated-transient LSF short-block divergence is fixed (the window-sequence cross-frame lookahead now measures exactly what the granule-0 detector it predicts measures, so the mandatory zero-line stop is never dropped); psycho-loop quality tuning remains open

crates.conformance: 136-138 dB SNR vs FFmpeg on six bundled fixtures
crates.notes: VorbisEncoder: floor 1 + coupled residue type 1, quality 0-10, square-polar stereo, exact input length via granule trimming. Remaining: block switching, per-file adaptive Huffman books, psychoacoustic masking, >2 channels, quality-to-bitrate calibration

crates.role: FFmpeg comparison harness, fuzz helpers, RFC 1321 MD5

crates.conformance: n/a (thin wrapper over the crates above)
crates.notes: Sniffs .ogg content (OpusHead vs \x01vorbis) since extension alone doesn't disambiguate; ships a minimal hand-rolled 16-bit PCM WAV writer for transcode output. Each format is behind its own Cargo feature (wav/aiff/flac/mp3/aac/opus/vorbis, all on by default) gating an optional dependency, so a single-format build drops the rest at compile time (measured: 1.38 MB release binary with all formats vs 544 KB with only wav)

crates.conformance: n/a (verified via a Node.js runtime smoke test, not a conformance suite)
crates.notes: Exports decode_<format>_to_f32 / <format>_sample_rate for every supported format; CI's wasm job builds for wasm32-unknown-unknown and runs test.js, verifying each format end to end (lossless exact; lossy via rate/duration/level).
